scope.analysis: Isolated four-branch r5 frontend, fixed code and Vctrl, real bias / native PDK resistors, prebiased .ic/uic working-state transient.
scope.edge_indexing: All stored edge and anomaly indices are zero-based; VCO edge indices refer to each case's signals.vco.positive_edges_s.
scope.frequency_algorithm: clock.period_stats(t, y, start=8e-9, stop=24e-9), default min_cycles=3; CMOS y=node-1.95/2 V.
scope.edge_algorithm: clock.edges within 8-24 ns; retain divider edges strictly bracketed by in-window VCO rising edges; np.interp(edge, vco_edges, np.arange(len(vco_edges))); diff versus k +/- 0.25.
scope.amplitude_algorithm: Window extrema/ptp use all stored samples with 8 ns <= t <= 24 ns; period_stats amplitude uses first-to-last complete rising-edge extent as defined in the shared function.

registered_boundary.description: FF cold r5 frontend working-state initial voltages from same-condition receiver and prescaler OP; not physical startup
registered_boundary.nodes: Approximate initial node voltages of the frontend and real bias; .ic with uic, no persistent forcing
registered_boundary.processing: Compose same-PVT receiver/VCO/bias OP and four mapped copies of a prescaler OP; reuse identical restorer helper state only for feedback; see probe.py assembled_seed
registered_boundary.validation: Native PDK SPARSE, 1 ns smoke and 24 ns complete at both passive corners; divider and four full-rate/feedback functional checks
valid_while: Exact consumer_sources hashes and unchanged code/control per point
Only the isolated four-branch r5 clock frontend boundary, not a TX or RX complete fixture
Prebiased working-state analysis only; no power-up, capture, noise or mismatch qualification
